title: Gopuff Product Availability
description: Per-UPC availability at a Gopuff micro-fulfillment center serving a partner customer.

mfc_id.description: Identifier of the Gopuff micro-fulfillment center returning availability.

upc.description: Universal Product Code used to map merchant SKUs to Gopuff catalog entries.

available.description: True when the item is currently in stock at the serving MFC.

quantity_on_hand.description: Approximate units available at the serving MFC.
